newsitem.title: USA: API says weekly data to be released after EIA data.
newsitem.headline: API says weekly data to be released after EIA data.

text.p: The American Petroleum Institute said Tuesday that it would release its weekly statistical bulletin between 0900 and 0930 EST (1400/1430 GMT) on Wednesday.
The report, which usually is released every Tuesday after the NYMEX and IPE futures markets close, was delayed because of technical problems.

The report will be released after the Energy Information Agency's weekly status report which is expected at 0900 EST and before the New York Mercantile Exchange futures market opens at 0945 EST, an API official said.
